name: overworld-seed-123-dungeon
comment: WP-1.7: chunk (1,1) of seed 123 gets a dungeon from its own population (WorldGenDungeons): mob spawner at (31,13,28), chests at (29,13,28) and (30,13,30). The chest loot and the spawner's mob reach this trace only as blocks; tick/dungeon-chest-save saves the tile entities.
